item.title: Norfolk's Davis makes weight, set for Saturday showdown with Ortiz
item.description: The Norfolk native weighed in at 139.2 lbs for Saturday's junior welterweight showdown against Jamaine Ortiz at Madison Square Garden. Ortiz also checked in at 139.2 lbs during Friday's festivities.

item.title: 757 artists and leaders take center stage during Grammy weekend in Los Angeles
item.description: Norfolk's Antonio Dowe and Billboard Magazine showcase 757 talent during Grammy weekend as Clipse earn five nominations including Album of the Year.

item.title: 14-year-old girl missing from Virginia Beach
item.description: Monica Watkins is a missing 14-year-old girl from Virginia Beach. She was last seen on Jan. 29 and left her home in Virginia Beach around 5:25 a.m.
